stories.title: Constitutional Court Overturns Conviction of Journalist for Police Criticism
stories.sum: The Constitutional Court has annulled the conviction of journalist Fonsi Loaiza for his comments regarding police involvement in the death of Mame Mbaye. Loaiza had faced a fine for calling the incident a 'murder' on Twitter.
stories.more: The court's ruling overturned a previous conviction and fine of 2,100 euros imposed on Loaiza for his statements. He linked the police's actions to the death of Mbaye in 2018, which the police denied, claiming it was due to natural causes. Different outlets offer varying emphasis on the implications of the ruling, particularly regarding police accountability and freedom of expression in journalism.
